profile.title: My profile
profile.description: Your name, the email you sign in with, and how Elysium looks on this device.

security.title: Sign-in & security
security.description: Your password, two-factor authentication, passkeys, lookup codes, and where you're signed in.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.description: Connect Claude Code, Codex, and other MCP clients, and disconnect the ones you've allowed.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.description: Your meeting sources, and your recent meetings as they reach their projects' timelines.

learnings.title: Learnings
learnings.description: What people and their agents learned, saved for the next agent, with every change kept.

learningCategories.title: Learning categories
learningCategories.description: The categories learnings are filed under: Elysium's built-in ones and your workspace's own.

users.title: Users
users.description: Approve sign-ups, manage roles and accounts, and choose who may join.

llms.title: Manage LLMs
llms.description: Connect language model providers, set their priority, and manage credentials.

email.title: Email
email.description: Connect Gmail and Outlook accounts, or create mailboxes on Elysium's own mail server.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Jira, GitHub, mail, and meetings: every service Elysium reads as you, its accounts, and their checks.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Choose where Elysium saves files: Bunny Storage, Amazon S3, or Google Cloud Storage.

environment.title: Environment variables
environment.description: Set variables every coding session's agent receives, such as registry tokens or build settings.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: See which release is running, follow auto-update, and check for a new release.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Choose where the databases are backed up every night, and see every backup.

passwords.title: Passwords
passwords.description: Connect the Bitwarden or Vaultwarden account agents sign in to things with.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose how Elysium looks. System follows your device's light or dark setting. Saved on this browser.
appearance.label: Theme
